rejected_rule.statement: The proper measure of compensation for improvements made by a co-owner is the cost of effecting the improvements or the present value of the improvements, whichever is less.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "The rights of a co-owner to compensation in a case such as we are considering is the same as that of a bona fide improver of property which is not his own, namely, that he is entitled to either the value of the improvements or to the difference between the original and the enhanced value of the property, which\u00a0ever is less."
